notes: Geometry and hours come from the data files behind the official Metro Flex service map embedded on the King County Metro Flex page. Both file paths include a release version (v3-2-5-4), so re-check the map iframe source on the Metro Flex page if they stop loading. Metro Flex Access On-Demand is a separate pilot for pre-qualified Access (paratransit) customers and is not mapped; it is not in the service-areas file. Zone hours were cross-checked against the hours file with no conflicts.
